lead.title: NHS England announces an £838M open framework for the future of GP IT systems
lead.deck: The framework (announced Oct 13) has three lots: foundation patient record (appointments, prescribing, referrals), clinical and operational support tools (decision support, video consultation) and R&D. Several suppliers can be appointed per lot; the procurement is due to open in November, with the framework launch expected in Q3 2027.

milestone.title: Accurx Scribe rolled out in older-people's mental health at Rotherham, Doncaster and South Humber NHS FT
milestone.summary: First service in a trust-wide rollout: the ambient voice tool listens to the consultation and drafts notes and referral letters, which the clinician reviews and signs off before they enter the record.
milestone.why: Each trust that adopts ambient voice pushes demand: England already has regional frameworks (Midlands, South West London) and North West London is preparing a tender.

deal.thesis: Series D led by Avidity Partners (with 8VC and GreatPoint Ventures) for RadOS, a cloud radiology platform merging PACS, reporting, viewer and worklist. Sirona is targeting international markets (UK, Europe, South Africa, New Zealand, Australia) through Sirona Global.

brefsEurope.title: NHS England awards Kainos £9.9M to build the "NHS Online Trust"
brefsEurope.summary: Data, DevOps and end-to-end development for the virtual hospital programme (Alpha phase 2): clinician workflow tooling, integration with national systems and the NHS App.

brefsEurope.company: North West London Acute Provider Group
brefsEurope.title: North West London consults suppliers ahead of its ambient voice (AVT) tender
brefsEurope.summary: Imperial, Chelsea and Westminster, London North West and Hillingdon are preparing a contract estimated to run from April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2030.

brefsEurope.title: UKRI funds a £2.4M wearables "living lab" in Manchester
brefsEurope.summary: Four-year Future Leaders Fellowship for Lukas Hughes-Noehrer, including an 800-patient trial in lung and hepato-pancreato-biliary surgery, with the MHRA (Manchester Sandbox).

word.definition: A tool that listens to the consultation, transcribes the conversation and automatically drafts a clinical note or letter for the clinician to validate.

how.t: The tool listens to the consultation in the room or by video.
It generates a draft of notes and referral letters.
The clinician reviews and signs each draft before it enters the patient record.

word.why: UK public procurement is accelerating: Heidi Health picked as sole supplier for 15 Midlands trusts (70,000 clinicians), Lyrebird for South West London (20,000 clinicians over 4 years), 19 scribes approved by the NHS in February. In continental Europe, Tandem Health raised a $100M Series B in September.
